findings.summary: Stale worker failure could reset another lease owner result
findings.resolution: Atomic fenced run/document transitions require matching token and unexpired lease; actual-service stale-worker regression added.

findings.summary: Redis redispatch could bypass transient retry budget
findings.resolution: Persisted attempts end after3; actual missing-object regression checks no fourth effect.

findings.summary: Lost PostgreSQL commit acknowledgement could delete committed original
findings.resolution: Primary candidate lookup before compensation; uncertain state preserves private object, actual commit-then-fault regression added.

findings.summary: Busy subtree could suppress loading live status or hide exposed busy state
findings.resolution: Separate exposed busy group from live status; final actualbrowser assertion passed.

findings.summary: Empty page could render reversed ranges
findings.resolution: Explicit empty page count; source and browser recheck.

findings.summary: Correction order and count could race
findings.resolution: Monotonic bounded revision reserved transactionally; canonical order used by UI.
Exact Origin/current verified membership and rate limit in onRequest before PDF buffering.

findings.summary: Clean noEmit typecheck could miss worker public test export
findings.resolution: Build worker after packages before workspace typechecks; clean CI verification pending.

findings.summary: PDF module lookup failed under actual integration runner and MIME rejection occurred too late
findings.resolution: Portable Node installed-module resolution;2actual-byte parser regressions pass independently. MIME guard moved into authorizedonRequest. Real-service rerun required.

limitations: Initial extraction supports bounded embedded PDF text and six labeled candidates; no OCR or universal table/field accuracy.
Operational JSON is documented demo contract only; no importer or real CargoWise/mail connector.
Application currently directly uses Prisma/concrete extraction adapter, explicit ADR0004 tradeoff; financial domain remains independent.
No real-auth browser E2E, complete assistive-tech audit, exact Figma fidelity or realcustomer validation.
Storage/DB commit is not distributed atomic; possible orphan objects require documented manual retention/cleanup.
Page/text/time/resource bounds implemented; not every encrypted/over-limit PDF variant exercised by current acceptance suite.
